payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a minimalist landing page. Use: white space, geometric layouts, sans-serif fonts, high contrast, grid-based structure, essential elements only. Avoid shadows and gradients. Focus on clarity and functionality.
payload.best_for: Enterprise apps, dashboards, documentation sites, SaaS platforms, professional tools
payload.css_technical_keywords: display: grid, gap: 2rem, font-family: sans-serif, color: #000 or #FFF, max-width: 1200px, clean borders, no box-shadow unless necessary
payload.do_not_use_for: Creative portfolios, entertainment, playful brands, artistic experiments
payload.effects_and_animation: Subtle hover (200-250ms), smooth transitions, sharp shadows if any, clear type hierarchy, fast loading
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Grid-based layout 12-16 columns, ☐ Typography hierarchy clear, ☐ No unnecessary decorations, ☐ text contrast measured against the chosen project target, ☐ Mobile responsive grid
payload.keywords: Clean, simple, spacious, functional, white space, high contrast, geometric, sans-serif, grid-based, essential
